items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let's see, there's some like Sally Trombone... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know if it's slide trombone. Something about slide trombone.

ctx.x: Trombone, baritone. That's why I took a liking to that baritone. Baritone, trombone. He didn't play all the instruments in the band though. I mean, he didn't play in the band, but he could play the instruments. Sliding trombone, he used to play a valve trombone. And when that piece, I can't remember that piece came on. That trombone had a part of it. Just then got a slide trombone for him. And the first day he got it, he played. Oh, that man could play in us.
Let's see, there's some like Sally Trombone, and Lasse's trombone, Lowe's trombone. There's a whole family of trombone people. Trombonium is one.
The only two we used was the valve trombone and the slide trombone.
